notes.title: Adventure Bundle now available on MacOS
notes.notes:
Crystal Shard Adventure Bundle is now available on MacOS, just like our other games Heroine's Quest, A Tale of Two Kingdoms, and Beer! The Mac build uses Adventure Game Studio version 3.6.1.25, and should run on any Mac 64-bit computer running MacOS 10.15 or above. The Windows and Linux builds have not been changed.

Gameplay has not changed, but I'll consider a patch later this year if the Mac users (or anyone else) finds some major bugs. Enjoy, everyone, and have a great spring!

notes.title: Bundle updated to newest AGS engine
notes.notes:
Crystal Shard Adventure Bundle has been updated to the latest stable version of Adventure Game Studio, 3.6.0 patch 6. This will improve stability on newer computers and compatibility with newer Windows versions.

A full list of engine changes can be [url=https://www.adventuregamestudio.co.uk/forums/ags-engine-editor-releases/ags-3-6-0-patch-6/]found here[/url].

In addition, this improves the German translation of Starship Quasar, and fixes a minor bug therein regarding the Morgana interface. The full version numbers are Larry Lotter 2.2, Quest for Yrolg 2.2, Starship Quasar 2.4, and META 1.5.

notes.title: Translation patch
notes.notes: Various of the translation / localization files have been patched; no change to English gameplay.

notes.title: META: free extra game
notes.notes:
Available as free DLC to the Adventure Bundle is our metagame META. A parody of amateur adventure design, it consists of a simple treasure hunting game, and a complex editor needed to complete it. The editor and its assistant Cuppit are all part of the game; anyone involved in game or level design should appreciate the humor. As an exercise of twisted logic and lateral thinking, with its offbeat controls, inventory items that kill you, and intentional misspellings, it's the weirdest thing since sliced bread!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/787280

notes.title: A Tale of Two Kingdoms
notes.notes:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/603870

Now available on Steam, A Tale of Two Kingdoms is a graphical adventure in the style of the classic Sierra games. Set in the world of Celtic mythology and fairy tales, it features many sidequests and alternate endings. This release is a Deluxe Edition with a new interactive prologue, several graphic updates, and professional voice acting.

[url]http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WLI4DeqFP80[/url]

The ancient kingdom of Theylinn is beset by enemies. Within the castle walls, nobles vie for the old king's favor, and not everybody is happy with the sole heir to the throne, princess Rhiannon. Meanwhile, danger approaches, in the form of an invading army, a hostile giant, and a mercenary troop who are ancient enemies of the Theylann king...

Now available from Steam!

notes.title: New Translations Available
notes.notes: As part of our ongoing effort to have our adventure games available to as many people as possible, and thanks to translator Pedro Galán Martín, the Adventure Bundle is now fully playable in Spanish. This brings the total language count to eight: English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish. Two out of three games are also available in Hungarian and Polish. Enjoy!
